review_evidence: README describes LeanSAT as a foundation for verified SAT reasoning and a verified bitblaster, later merged into Lean core.
The LeanSAT/ production subtree contains 111 Lean files and approximately 575 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations, independently of Test/ and Eval/.
The repository includes proof-producing/verifying SAT infrastructure and bitvector reasoning rather than only tactic application wrappers.
summary: Retain LeanSAT as a substantive verified SAT/bit-blasting development with large theorem-bearing production modules.
